name: How much does it cost to build a detached garage in the Las Vegas area?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to build a detached garage in the Las Vegas area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of building a detached garage in the Las Vegas area varies significantly based on size, materials, foundation type, chosen amenities, and site preparation needs. A basic single-car garage might start around $20,000, while a larger two-car garage with custom finishes, electrical, and plumbing could range from $40,000 to $70,000 or more. Obtaining detailed quotes from local contractors is essential to get an accurate estimate tailored to your specific project requirements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for a detached garage in Las Vegas vary widely, from $20,000 for a basic single-car to over $70,000 for a larger, customized build. Factors include size, materials, and features.
